Comparer for `normalizacao_do_jogador` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the comparer of `0x538bc0` and `0x538ec0`. \n Compares the whole player (70 bytes) and byte `+0x58` of the person, with the training manager ([`0xde1f44`]) zeroed on both sides (taking away and giving back the progress touches the training tables, outside the regions); with a training manager, the original routine then runs for real from the same state.

Comparer for `add_ban` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): `0x556940` reallocates the vectors and links the bodies (it cannot run twice). \n The plan first, then the original routine runs; it checks the old ban extended (matches, days, bit 0 of both), or the new one in the slot (matches, days, the 4 rules), the count, the rule entries pointing to the slot and, with the fourth rule, the nations index with one more.

Comparer for `injury_daily_update` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): side-by-side comparer of the training phase. \n The copy runs as a dry run (without freeing the list, without the new injury and without the final routines) and the original routine from the same state (the Injury header, the injury table and the random draw); the original is checked when it reaches the return-from-injury news (`0x62e010`, detoured in the same item), before the final routines. With a new injury (it allocates and sends news) or with everyone's fitness (day 180 of the first season): only the original routine.

Comparer for `roll_recurring_injury` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): `0x62d250` (treat) cannot run twice. \n The plan first, with the random-draw state saved (without counting or tracing) and the record marks restored; then the original routine runs. It checks the marks of the record and of the chosen one and, outside the treat path, that the random-draw state equals the plan's (the same random draws).

Comparer for `remove_staff_from_club` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the original routine removes the contract and removes the person from the media and from the human's lists (it cannot run twice). \n Only it runs, and the plan made beforehand with the body (`detach_staff_from_club`) over copies of the person's fields and the club's slots is checked. A human person: only the original routine (the human's lists may touch the club).

Comparer for `build_match_details_screen` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The details screen is compared through the display list when the match's record and picture already exist (parameters `0x1f` and `0x20`) and there is no picture `0x1d` to free. Only the original routine when they are created here (allocation) or on tabs 1 (the summary narrates with sound), 3 (the zones allocate the picture) and 4 (the report is created).

Comparer for `fill_team_stats_rows` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The cells are really compared: building (`modo` ≠ 0) through the display list, local update through the manager's `Display`; the parameters (`0x1a`) and the text `0xde1f64` too. An update that goes over the network or parameter `0x1c` other than 1 and 2: only the original routine.

Comparer for `resposta` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Both responses are really compared on clicks (the screen's parameter block and the marks `0xb6b7a8`/`ac`/`b0`, plus the return value); when there is a redraw (the 5-second switch of the scores, new statistics data) only the original routine runs, because the redraw writes the time into parameter `0x14` and touches the display list.

Comparer for `process_transfer_squad_reactions` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): a dry-run comparer. \n The copy runs without news or transfer request (it stops when it reaches one) and the original routine from the same state: the random draw, [`0xae1080`] (the player sheet of the last contract), the static date of `0x54cdb0`, the new club's supporters row in [[`0xb67a44`]] and, for each member of the two clubs' squads (and the person of the media story), the contract with the club (0x50 bytes) and the opinions row in [`0xae2d0c`] (0x4f bytes). When the copy stops: only the original routine.

Comparer for `withdraw_injured_player` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the withdrawal calls the news (allocates), the removal from the tactics and the replacement (original routines with side effects), so only the original routine runs. \n The path is decided beforehand, read-only (release_plan), and checked afterwards: without withdrawal, the national team's club (`+0x24`) and the call-up mark (`+0x28`) remain; with withdrawal, the player who was in one of the team's 50 slots leaves them (`+0x24` zeroed by `0x7762f0`). Without a club (the box): only the original routine.

Comparer for `national_teams_daily_update` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the original routine calls up players (`0x76bab0`: news, squads), reschedules matches (`0x7777e0`), allocates the table (`0x7775c0`) and frees items (`0x68d1f0`), so it cannot run twice. \n Only it runs, checking the plan of what the routine itself writes: no item for today is left in the list at `+0`.

Comparer for `process_regen_queue` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): `0x7abac0` (the young regen) allocates the contract and sends news, and the manager reserves recreate persons found along the way, so only the original routine runs, checking the queue plan. \n With no expired entry and no reserves to recreate, both run side by side on the header (nothing changes). With expired entries (the regen may add new entries to the queue), reserves (more than 2) or an invalid id: only the original routine.

Comparer for `build_career_history` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): both build the table (the original routine and the copy, from the same state; the history file is only read) and compare the count and the entries. \n The copy's table is freed (`0x9452ca`) and the game carries on with the original's. The error cases (box): only the original routine.

Comparer for `player_stats_record_match` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): side-by-side comparer. \n Compares the double sums (`+0x10`..`+0x30`), the category records of each row that counts, the range `+0x20`..`+0x27` of the player's record and `+0x3b` of the contract; in the simulated match (competition −2), also the random-draw state (and the two possible categories), with the copy's random draw left out of the count. A null match or fixture, the box of a competition with no known type, or a category record still to be created (`0x7c5d80` grows the vector): only the original routine.

Comparer for `update_staff_status` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): side by side. \n Compares the two pair vectors and their counts, the byte of the person's list count, the 40 slots and `+8` of the club's entry, byte `+0x4f` of the contract and the static dates, and the return value. In the recursion of event 4 and in event 1 that fills the slot, only the original routine (the copy covers those branches).

Comparer for `update_coach_assignments` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): side by side on the human's staff (54 bytes) and on the club's mark `+0x244` (`0x53cb80`/`0x53cc30` via `0x540a50` may zero it). \n Without a human or with a national team's club: side by side only on the mark. A manager outside the 16 humans (`0x8b4cd0` shows the box and the original routine would write to null): only the original routine.

Comparer for `add_transfer_offer` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the comparer of `0x8be300`; only the original routine runs (it allocates the offer and the lists, removes the old offer, schedules, delivers the news). \n It checks the plan made beforehand: the slot (`find_offer_slot_and_rival`, with the vector that grows when full) and the serial number written into the incoming offer, and the serial that goes up.

Comparer for `remove_exchange_player` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the comparer of `0x8c41c0`; only the original routine runs. \n The exchange nodes are freed, the news goes to the managers and the offer continues via `0x8c2f50`, which may close the transfer and remove other players from exchanges, or be answered by the computer seller, `0x8c8090`, which may change the slot's offer.

Comparer for `check_squad_limits` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs): the comparer of `0x8cd450`. \n The copy runs as a dry run (without releasing) and then the original routine, from the same state ([`0xae1080`], the reason, the cursors of the free queue and of the exchange). Without a release: the return value and those regions must be equal. With a release (the copy saved the chosen one): the return value must be equal and the chosen one must have left the club (his contract, via `0x4cf5a0` which only reads, without the club); the rest the original redoes when releasing. Null club: the box, only the original routine.

The three contract bonuses paid for a summary slot (Finance::pay_bonuses `0x599960`). \n `+0x21` × `+0x10`, `+0x27` × `+0x14` and, with the summary word = 1 and `+0x22`, `+0x27` × `+0x18` (the original routine uses `+0x27` again); each only when the byte and the value are positive. \n No bonus in a friendly (`0x5c6710`), in a match of competition [`0x9cf684`] or for contract types 5 and 6.

Whether the transfer window is open for the club of the person's contract. \n The key nation index (`0x669340` of the club's nation; with no nation, the low byte of the club pointer that the original routine reads from the argument slot) gives the two dates of table `0xb63d8a` (72 bytes per nation): true when today is after the first and before the second.

Whether a suspension of type `t` (type vector [this], 4 bytes each) applies at the loan club. \n By the type's competition (`+0x17`, −1 = none) being equal to the club's nation (`+0x53`, id at `+0`); with no competition, by `+0x1b` (−1: applies) being equal to [`+0x71`] of the nation. Club with no nation: does not apply.

The match wrap-up: `0x6d1cc0` (cdecl, `match_eng.cpp`, called by the engine step `0x6b98c0`) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected. 
 Injected: `0x6d26b0` (each player's player sheet), `0x6d3610` and `0x6d3de0` (the reputations), `0x68d0d0` (copying an event into list [`0xb67dc8`]). 
 With the day's event list (`+0x478e`) and the match (`+0x4792`, `+0x40` set), it walks the events (`0x68d1b0`): `0x82` goes to the list; `0x1e` (offer?) by the score (`+0x43`/`+0x44`, a draw by the clubs' strength `+0x80` × 1.2/0.8) and by the manager on the other side (`+0xd3`, `0x544410` drawn against 20 or 5, `+0x14` > 5) marks the event (`+0xe` 1, `+0xf` the manager) or compares it with the strength of the event's club (`+0x80` with two random draws of 1000, or above 7000; on the other side, 1 in 4) and marks it (`+0xe` 0, `+0xf` −1); the others, of the match player: for 6 by the marks `+0x24`/`+0x23`, for the rest with `+0x1b` < 7 by random draw(`+0x17`). 
 Then, per side, each player on the pitch (substitutes only if they came on, `+0x1f`) with a player sheet and a contract: `0x6d26b0` with the rating `+0x1b`; with the list: outside national teams and friendlies, not being the manager, a player who went off (`+0x20`) without being substituted back (`+0x22`) and with a contract (`+0x3d`) and reputation (`+0xb` > 4250) may ask to leave (event 0xa, 0x4000000) by random draws of `+0x1a2`, `+0x5d`, stamina (`+0x4d`) and `+0x57`/`+0x5b`; the unhappiness (−`+0x31`, +10 against the rival `+0xb3`/`+0xb7`/`+0xbb` or rejected by the opponent `0x5477d0`, −10 if his favourite `0x547790`, +10/−20 by the preferences `0x547d30`/`0x547d60`) against random draw((`+0x5a` × `+0x5b` × `+0x5d` + 20) × 100) generates event 0xb. 
 The average of the ratings by minutes played (90 in the fast engine; `+0x21`/`+0x20`/minute, minus the entry `+0x1f`), −0.25 at home (`+0x18`) or +0.25 away, goes to `0x6d3610` and, outside national teams, `0x6d3de0`. Without minutes, the average stays that of the previous side (for the 1st side it was stack garbage: 0 in the determinized original, like the final 4 bytes of the event built on the stack).

Self-test (`CM_AUTOTESTE=1`, comparison mode) of three routines that neither the career nor the save goes through (the database is version 2; the test game is in English). \n (1) The competitions converter: 64 cases with fixed seeds, from 1 to 6 records, a temporary file (`autoteste_banco_v1c.tmp` in the game folder, deleted at the end) with random bytes (1 in 4 all zeros), whole (1 in 3) or cut at a random point, with the buffer starting random. \n (2) The English names: 256 cases with language 0, 1, 2, 3 or 13 and a fake `eng.lng` table (never null: the first use would load the real file), with and without the id map, ids from −2 to 11 (in the map, from 0 to 7); the globals are restored at the end.

Self-test of the version 1 converters (`CM_AUTOTESTE=1`, comparison mode: the factory database and the save are version 2 and the career does not go through them). \n For each converter, 64 cases with fixed seeds: from 1 to 6 records, a temporary file (`autoteste_banco_v1.tmp` in the game folder, deleted at the end) with random bytes (1 case in 4 all zeros: the club's reputation 0), whole (1 in 3) or cut at a random point (the read fails in the middle of a field), opened by the game's `fopen` `0x945b00`; the buffer starts random (the record's holes are included in the comparison).

The human manager record of the person (`human_manager.cpp`). \n The 16 human managers are the last 16 persons (index = id − number of persons in `0xae2364` + 16), 42,735-byte records starting at `+0` of the object, count at `+4`. Without a person, it uses the current manager's (table `0xb74c26`, 768 bytes per manager, index in the word `0xb77c7a`). `None`: no person at all, or index out of range (the bool says which).

A player's injury during the match: `0x6d0980` (ret 0x10, `match_eng.cpp`) with the copy into the injury list (`0x68d0d0`) injected; decides and applies the injury of player `p` (fitness loss, leaving the pitch, counters). 
 With more than 3 injuries in the match (`+0xf639`), non-zero random draw(injuries) and random draw(500) prevent it; with more than 6, never. A valid type: records it (`0x62be00`, which returns type and severity). `+0x55` = `o` (the player who caused it loses 10 in `+0x31`). 
 Severity above 50: removes severity^2 from stamina (`+0x4d`) and marks `+0x1c`; otherwise removes random draw(severity^2 / 2), writes random draw(that × 0.5) into `+0x59` and halves `+0xd5`. 
 Stamina below the limit: he leaves (`+0x8eb5`, `+0x1d`, `+0x1c`); otherwise he stops (`0x7160e0` with 5 or 3) according to the person's strength (`+0x2d` × 25). Stamina is kept between 1 and the ceiling; when leaving, one more injury in the match.

The plan of `0x62e500`: the random draws and the record marks for a recurring injury; the rest is left to the caller (RecurringInjuryOutcome). 
 1 in 20 (random draw 0x14) and injury `tipo` able to recur ([`0x9e7ae0` + 13 × `tipo`]): the record without a recurring injury takes it (`+0x12` = `tipo`, `+0x13` = 0). 
 Of the records with a recurring injury (`+0x12` ≠ 0xff), the one with the highest score (random draw 0x65 − 5 × level − the player's person `+0x2d`; 100 without a player, signed bytes), stopping at the first with 95 or more. 
 Found: a club player (`+0x39`) with reputation (`+0x80`) above 4250, a club without a human (`0x600a50`) and 1 in 3 (random draw 3): treat; otherwise clear its mark.

Whether the copy seeded the CRT `rand` from the clock (the physiotherapists were assessed). \n If so, the comparer does not check the `rand` state (the clock moves between the original routine and the copy in the real game).

The comparer of the three manager-news routines. \n The copy runs as a dry run (without delivering) and the original routine from the same state (the `regioes` and the random draw). Must be equal: the `regioes`; the copy's random draws are the beginning of the original's (the automatic reply of the delivery may draw afterwards); and each human manager whose inbox (News `+8`: 12 bytes per human, start of the ring at `+0`, next slot at `+4`) advanced received the copy's news: type (`+0`), data and date (`+5`..`+0xd6`) and the scope (`+0xde`); with no planned delivery, no inbox advances.

`0x6ccb60` with the call to `0x6cd330` injected: walks the cells of the line from (x0, y0) to (x1, y1) looking for a player. \n Uses the major axis with accumulated error, Bresenham-style; the final cell is only included if the line is a single point. In each cell it asks `search_on_side` for a player of a randomly drawn side and then of the other, with the distance from the origin (12 × 9 table; outside it, 1000). The first hit returns 1; leaving the pitch or reaching the end returns 0. The type (by `codigo`) is passed along.

`0x6be710` (ret 4, `match_eng.cpp`) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected (`0x6d6f70` narrates, `0x702050` takes the kick, `0x7109f0` moves the goalkeeper): one step of the penalty shootout by state `+0x8eb3`. 
 States 1 and 4 set up (zero the move, save and silence the commentator in `+0x8ea4`, five kicks per side in `+0x8ea1`/`+0x8ea2`, side 1 or the drawn one starts, `0x6be520`) and go to 2 and 5. 
 States 2 and 5: with no kicks left comes sudden death (one each, `+0x8ea3`); the taker is the next one in the side's list (`+0x1af` + 11 × side, `+0x8e9f` counts), the goalkeeper is the other side's (`0x6ce110`); it marks who took the kick (`+0x8eda`); the strength comes from random draw(`+0x35` of the player sheet) and the kicks remaining, and grows (× 2.25 with narration 0x2005 when the side needs to score, × 0.75 with 0x2006 when it can decide). With `modo` 3 the kick (`0x700bd0` and `0x702050`) is taken directly; otherwise it positions the taker, the goalkeeper and the others (`0x6f46b0`, `0x7160e0`), the kick direction by strength, and the goalkeeper reacts (`0x714d40`, up to 4 times `0x7109f0`) before the kick. It passes the turn and, once the score is decided (`+0xf5bc` × `+0xf5f2` with the kicks remaining), goes to 3 (mode 4) or 6. 
 States 3 and 6 narrate the result (0x2004), write the shootout score into the match (`+0x49`/`+0x4a`) and give the commentator back.

`CM3_MATCH_ENGINE::get_opposition_challenge` (`0x6c87e0`, ret 0x24, `match_eng.cpp`, ~5.3 KB): picks which of the active opponents in the ball's cell challenges move `tipo` of `atacante` (or of side `lado`, with no attacker). \n The ball's distance to goal (table `0xa15e44`, 1000 outside it) gives the difficulty `dist`. Each standing opponent (`+0x2b` < 2) gets a weight: 3.5 with `+0x8ea9` = 4, otherwise by the tactical marks (`0x7163c0`, or the side's strategy byte with 0x200) 0.5, 4 or 2; times 0.05 far from goal, 2.25 if he marks the attacker (`+0x1a6`), doubled if he chases him (`+0x1aa`), the random draw by reading of the game (`+0x106`) and the attacker's `+0x19c`, form (`+0x24`, `+0x106`, `+0x75`), stamina (`+0x4d`, outside table 1), 1/4 with the side's strategy 5; at least 0.05. \n Each `tipo` has its own contest: random draw(k / weight) against `+0x10d` + `+0x10a` − `dist` (variants for 0x11/0x12, 0x15 with the 5th power (CRT `pow`) of how many are in the cell, 0x6c with 10.5 − `dist`). The winner receives a code and the alternative moves; offside (`0x6cb780`) and position decide `*arriscado`, the value (`0x7165b0`, `0x5407e0`, `0x6f5b20`) chooses between the moves, and control (`0x70d690`) gives the score. The one with the highest score is written to `*nota`/`*lance` and tires (`0x6f56c0` with −1). Returns that opponent or 0.

True when a recording (tape) is open and we are at its top level, outside any recorded unit currently running. \n Then the routine is called directly by the one being compared and goes into the tape (or just passes through). Inside a unit, it can be compared on its own (the outer tape is kept aside).

Runs the original routine recording the calls and the Rust copy replaying them (`reproduzir`). \n Returns both responses, whether the regions came out equal and whether the call sequence matched. \n What diverged in the last tape comparison (recorded call vs requested call, different regions), for the divergence message. It is only built when there is a difference.

The staff object `c` picks the club's formation (`+0x2f`) and loads the tactic into the engine (`0x6e0230`, thiscall, ret 0x10, `match_man.cpp`). Returns 0. 
 With the engine at `+0` it draws a random formation; with `modo` != 2 it only reloads; with a human manager to be consulted (`0x5fd210`/`0x5fea50`) it uses his tactic (`0x5fbe20`, `0x5fbd00`). 
 Otherwise it rates (`0x6e2f20`) each sector (7, bits 1..0x40) and band (5, bits 0x80..0x800) from the two best of the `n` persons in `fichas` (the goalkeeper only in the middle band; with fewer than 11, the last sector counts half and the wings of sectors 1 to 3 get the lowest), and judges each formation of the tactics bank (`0xde1d08`): the time (`+2`, up to 3000) and the mentality (`0x6df460`) weigh the formation's rating (`+0x10`/`+0x18`/`+0x20`, up to 3), the manager adjusts (`+0x1c`, `+0xe`, `+0x1f`; the favourite `+0x43` counts ×1.1 or up to ×3.75, the others ×0.1) and each slot adds the rating of its sector and band (`0x5b2ae0`) and the marks (`0x5b5270`/`0x5b57c0`); the balance of the sectors comes in through the mentality. 
 It saves the best (`0x8967d0`), copies the tactic (`0x896660`) into the engine (`+0x91e2` of the side) and into `+0x2b` and sets the instructions (`0x6ddab0`). The formations' ratings are kept in a list from the game's CRT (`0x945501`/`0x9452ca`). Returns 0.

The form bonus (flag 2) added to the sum. \n The rating `0x7c1e30(6)` capped by the average (or by `l3c`), limited for players over 33 when `teto_veterano`, weighted by the days with observer `quem`, plus the ratings `0x7c1e30(1)` and `0x7c1e30(6, 0x14, `ultimo`)` at the club (or the same nation).

The fatigue of match player `reg` to subtract from stamina (`+0x35`). \n −2000 for the human manager (`+0x904d` of the side, without `0x5fd210`, national team or `0x5fd480`) with the player below 11 (`+0`); off the pitch (`+0x19` = −1) the remaining minutes × 150 (up to 3000; goalkeeper only +3500, the others at least −2000); on the pitch, the minutes played (minute − `+0x1f`) below 60 × 40.

Player `j` contests the incoming ball with `forca` (move `tipo` 0..5, height `p4`): `0x6f5c30` (ret 0x10, `match_pl.cpp`) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected. Returns 1 if the play resolved on him (he controlled it, was fouled, the ball broke loose), 0 if not. 
 Injected: `0x6d6f70` narrates, `0x716e10` tires, `0x6cd770` the ball breaks loose, `0x6f0630` control; and those inside the leaving-the-pitch path. 
 The taker (`+0xf576`) does not contest; on the side without the ball, with `+0x10d` × 2 < random draw(6) and the row outside the limit (`0x6cb930`), neither. The attack is random draw(2000 − `+0xa5` × 40) for the goalkeeper in his own area, otherwise by type (500, 600, 700, 1000, 1800; type 5 is random draw(500000) + 200 and becomes 4); with `p4` < 1.5 types 4 and 5 do not contest; with height, attack × (`+0x8eaa` + 1) / (`p4` + 1). 
 With the ball on his own side (`+0x8eab`) and random draw(attack + 100) == 0: 0x1f5e, −300 in `+0x4782` and the ball breaks loose. Otherwise the move and the attribute: in his own area the goalkeeper (or, outside the area and by random draw, the header 0x25 with `+0x164`) chooses between control (1, `+0x11c`), 0x15 (`+0x144`), 0x24 (`+0x162`) and 0x29 (`+0x16c`); the score is random draw(attribute) − `forca` / 2 − attack: below −100 he only gains random draw(2) in `+0x2b`; below 150 nothing. 
 The referee looks at the foul (`0x6cfca0`): 1 in 10 records it (`0x6bb9a0`), otherwise punishes (`0x6cfd10`) with 0x1fe8, card, set piece 7, penalty (5, −500 in `+0x35` and, by random draw(`+0x5a` of the player sheet), adjustment of `+0x17` and performance `0x6eecb0`) or foul (6), sending-off, taker (`0x6ceb90`) and the narrations 0x21df to 0x21e2, and outside the special moves 0x20df/0x20e0/0x20d9, the team's wear (`0x6bb8d0`) and the fatigue. 
 Without punishment: the limit is 1500 − `p4`^2 × 100 + `+0x8eaa` × 100 (minimum 160); with the score within it, `p4` >= 1 and above `+0x8eaa` + 1, the player controls the ball (`+0x2b`, 0x1fe2 for the goalkeeper in the area or 0x1f5f, `0x6f0630`, marks the move, 0x21cd/0x21ce by the success average); otherwise he loses it (0x20d4 for the goalkeeper in the area, or 0x213e/0x1f71) and the ball breaks loose (`0x6cd770`). With `conta`, +1 in `+0x12` and stamina (`+0x1c` or +10).

Player `p` moves one cell (two, if fast) towards (x, y) with action `codigo` (0xf, 0x11, 0x12...): `0x6f09f0` (ret 0x14, `match_pl.cpp`) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected. 
 Injected: `0x6d6f70` narrates, `0x714d40` releases the marked players, `0x6f0630` control, `0x716e10`/`0x716c90`, `0x6cd770` set piece, `0x6cd490` ball out, `0x68d0d0` the event; and those of the injury, the foul and leaving the pitch. 
 Already at the target (other than 0xf and 0x100) it only releases the marked players. Without the ball: injury in the challenge (`0x6cfe10`) and, if not facing the target (`0x6fa140`), it only turns (`0x6f4920`, `+0x198` = 0x6f). 
 With the ball: the attack from stamina, `+0x19c` and the action, the narration of the approach (0x2156..0x2162), the challenger (`0x6c87e0`) with the foul (`0x6cfc60`/`0x6cfcd0`, as in the challenge, with event 0x82) or the clean contest; if the challenger wins, his move (`0x70d430` in 1) and the end as in the challenge; getting past him, possession, `+0x19c`, the move counts and the action's narrations (0x1f48/0x1f49; 0x2009, 0x20d1..0x20d3, 0x1f4a.. in 0x11 and 0x12); losing control (`+0x1d` or random draw), 0x1f42.
